approval.by: project owner (chat 2026-10-19: 按这个方案来做吧，弄完直接发布)

overall.zh: Agent 安全研究的快速增长，正在形成怎样的安全证据？这些证据能否被比较、被独立复用，并随着新发现得到修正？
overall.en: What safety evidence is the fast growth of agent-safety research producing — and can it be compared, reused independently, and revised as new findings arrive?

overallAnswer.zh: 证据在快速增加，但能直接比较、被独立复用的部分还有限：研究方向通过共同基准相连，同名基准下却普遍存在条件差异或信息不足；多数基准引用未检测到实际使用；研究转向执行类场景时，真实系统上的实验没有随之增加；针对防御的外部反例不多，被挑战的论文也大多没有更新。
overallAnswer.en: Evidence is growing fast, but the part that can be compared directly or is reused independently is still limited: research directions are linked through shared benchmarks, yet papers on a benchmark of the same name commonly differ in conditions or report too little; most citations of benchmarks come with no detected use; as research turned to settings where the agent acts, experiments on real systems did not grow with it; outside counter-evidence against defences is uncommon, and most challenged papers are not updated.

claim.zh: 仅凭同一个基准名称，就能直接比较两篇论文的结果。
claim.en: Two papers can be compared directly because they name the same benchmark.

why.zh: 逐对比较同一基准上论文的版本、判据与被测模型：多数论文对条件不同或信息不足。
why.en: Pairs of papers on one benchmark compared on version, criterion and models tested: most differ or report too little.

claim.zh: 基准由原作者团队自己使用时，评测条件更一致。
claim.en: When a benchmark's own authors use it, the set-ups are more alike.

why.zh: 只比较同一基准内的两类论文对；同时具备两类论文对的基准只有 5 个，不能据此普遍否定这种关系。
why.en: Only pairs inside the same benchmark are compared; just 5 benchmarks have both kinds, so the relation is not ruled out in general.

claim.zh: 平台展示的潜力信号，能提前认出会增长的方向。
claim.en: The platform's potential signals pick out directions that will grow.

why.zh: 在不同年份上回测同一组信号；结论限于被测试的信号组合和年份。
why.en: The same signals back-tested on different years; the result is limited to the signals and years tested.

claim.zh: 基准越来越多，共同评测基础会被稀释。
claim.en: As benchmarks multiply, the common evaluation ground thins out.

why.zh: 只用完整的半年比较；在所比较的时间窗口内未观察到共用比例明确下降，这不等于排除了影响。
why.en: Only complete half-years compared; no clear drop is seen within the windows compared, which does not rule an effect out.

claim.zh: 论文声称保护到哪一层，就测到了哪一层。
claim.en: Papers measure the layer they claim to protect.

why.zh: 逐篇对照声称与实际测量的层次：总体多数一致；在明确涉及实际后果的子样本中，不匹配更突出。
why.en: Each paper's claimed layer set against the layer measured: most match overall; in the subsample that explicitly concerns real consequences, mismatch stands out.

claim.zh: 引用量能反映成果被实际采用的程度。
claim.en: Citation counts show how far work is actually adopted.

why.zh: 在同一张“工作—基准”关系表上同时看引用与使用：两者相关，但引用不能替代采用检测。
why.en: Citation and use read on one table of work-benchmark pairs: they are related, but citation cannot stand in for detecting use.

claim.zh: 单条冷门方向很难翻身。
claim.en: A single cold direction rarely rises.

why.zh: 追踪冷门研究线后来是否进入头部：单条翻身的比例低；但新进入头部的线多数来自冷门群体。
why.en: Cold lines traced to see whether they later reach the top: few single lines do; yet most lines that newly reach the top come from the cold group.

claim.zh: 较早连接多个方向的工作，带动了后来方向的增长。
claim.en: Early works that link several directions drive the later growth of directions.

why.zh: 引用优势并非增长方向独有（安慰剂检验）；是否促进增长没有检验，因果作用尚不能判断。
why.en: The citation advantage is not special to growing directions (a placebo test); whether such works drive growth was not tested.

claim.en: Cold directions are not worth attention.

why.zh: 这是价值与投入回报的判断，本次没有检验。
why.en: This is a judgement of value and return on effort, not tested here.

claim.zh: 研究转向执行类场景后，验证方式也随之更新。
claim.en: When research turns to settings where the agent acts, its testing turns with it.

why.zh: 按半年对齐执行类场景的占比，与真实系统实验、摘要报告自适应攻击的比例；标签来自标题与摘要。
why.en: The share of work in those settings aligned by half-year with the shares run on real systems and reporting adaptive attacks; labels from titles and abstracts.

claim.zh: 原作者不引用反例，是因为后来不再做这个方向。
claim.en: Authors do not cite counter-evidence because they have left the topic.

why.zh: 看反例出现之后，防御团队是否还有新的 Atlas 工作：多数仍在发表。
why.en: Whether the defence's team has later Atlas works after the counter-evidence: most do.

claim.zh: 原作者会特别回避针对自己防御的反例。
claim.en: Authors particularly avoid counter-evidence against their own defence.

why.zh: 与同一批防御收到的其他外部引用比较，原团队后来引用的比例相近；反例样本较小。
why.en: Set against the other outside citations to the same defences, the teams cite back at a similar rate; the counter-evidence sample is small.

claim.zh: 防御被外部反例挑战后，会在新版本中收紧主张。
claim.en: Once challenged by outside counter-evidence, a defence narrows its claim in a new version.

why.zh: 读每篇被挑战防御在反例之后的 arXiv 版本，并对比前后两版摘要；只看 arXiv 与摘要。
why.en: The arXiv versions of each challenged defence after the challenge, with the abstracts before and after compared; arXiv and abstracts only.

q.zh: 研究关注如何变化，哪些方向容易被忽略，变化能否被可靠识别
q.en: How attention moves, which directions are overlooked, and whether change can be spotted reliably

q.zh: 研究用什么资源与实验支持安全主张，结论适用于哪些条件
q.en: What resources and experiments support safety claims, and under which conditions they hold

q.zh: 共享基础能否支持比较，成果能否被独立团队实际采用
q.en: Whether shared foundations support comparison, and whether work is taken up by independent teams

q.zh: 开放问题和外部反例如何得到回应，主张是否随新证据修订
q.en: How open problems and outside counter-evidence are answered, and whether claims are revised

name.en: Where research is, and the move to execution

name.zh: 共同基准如何连接研究
资源是否被外部团队采用
name.en: Are resources taken up by outside teams

name.zh: 开放问题与新证据如何得到回应
name.en: How open problems and new evidence are answered

title.zh: 共同评测基础是否已经形成：被提出的基准有多少已被其他团队采用？
title.en: Has a shared evaluation base formed: how many benchmarks have other teams taken up?

title.zh: 很少互相引用的研究方向，是否通过共同基准建立了实际联系？
title.en: Do directions that rarely cite each other connect through shared benchmarks?

title.zh: 论文产出最多的机构，是否也提供了最多被外部使用的评测资源？
title.en: Do the institutions that publish most also supply the evaluation resources others use most?

title.zh: 基准数量增加，是否必然削弱共同评测基础？
title.en: Does a growing number of benchmarks necessarily weaken the shared evaluation base?

title.zh: Agent 安全的研究对象与攻击入口在怎样变化？
title.en: How are the objects and entry points of agent-safety research changing?

title.zh: 论文代码公开之后，是否被复制和持续维护？
title.en: Once paper code is public, is it copied and kept up?

title.zh: 较早连接多个方向的工作，是否更可能出现在后来增长的方向中？
title.en: Are works that connect several directions early more likely to sit in directions that grow later?

title.zh: 被反复提出的开放问题，后来得到了什么形式的回应？
title.en: What kind of response do repeatedly raised open problems get?

title.zh: 自动裁判是否实际评判了同家族模型的结果？
title.en: Do automatic judges actually grade models of their own family?

title.zh: 开放权重模型与 API 模型是否承担不同的研究角色？
title.en: Do open-weight and API models play different roles in research?

short.zh: 开放与 API 模型的角色
short.en: Roles of open and API models

title.zh: 单个冷门方向翻身的概率低，但新进入头部的方向里有多少来自冷门群体？
title.en: Each cold direction rarely rises, but how many new head entries come from the cold group?

title.zh: 平台展示的潜力信号，能否在未来数据中稳定识别增长方向？
title.en: Do the platform's early signals pick out growing directions on later data?

title.zh: 机器人和物理 agent 接入语言模型、工具、检索与记忆后，相关安全研究是否覆盖了这些连接？
title.en: As robots and physical agents take up language models, tools, retrieval and memory, does safety research cover these connections?

short.zh: 物理 agent 的连接覆盖

title.zh: 论文用了新模型，是否意味着它测试的对象也是新模型？
title.en: Does using a new model mean the model under test is new?

short.en: How new the tested models are

title.zh: 评测是否集中依赖少数基准、裁判和被测模型？
title.en: Does evaluation lean on a few benchmarks, judges and tested models?

title.zh: 两篇论文使用同一个基准时，能否直接比较它们的结果？
title.en: When two papers use the same benchmark, can their results be compared directly?

title.zh: 一个基准的采用，有多少发生在提出者之外的团队？
title.en: How much of a benchmark's uptake happens outside its authors' teams?

title.zh: 被广泛引用的成果，是否也被实际使用？
title.en: Are widely cited works also actually used?

title.zh: 报告安全提升的研究，是否同时说明了任务能力保留和成本？
title.en: Do papers reporting safety gains also show retained task ability and cost?

title.zh: 攻防结论在多大范围的模型能力、预算和访问权限下成立？
title.en: Under what range of capability, budget and access do attack and defence results hold?

title.zh: 论文声称保护的层次，与它实际测量的层次一致吗？
title.en: Is what a paper claims to protect measured at the same layer?

title.zh: 系统同时使用工具、记忆、检索和多 agent 协作时，研究是否直接验证了风险在连接处的传播？
title.en: When systems combine tools, memory, retrieval and multiple agents, is risk propagation across those links tested directly?

title.zh: 跨方向引用时，是明确使用成果、采用方法，还是只作背景提及？
title.en: When work is cited across directions, is it used, its method adopted, or only mentioned?

title.zh: 一种防御出现外部反例后，原团队是否引用了反例、更新了论文？
title.en: After outside counter-evidence against a defence, do its authors cite it or update the paper?

reason.zh: 说明研究重心正移向工具、执行与工作流，是“验证处于什么状态”这条线的起点
reason.en: Shows attention moving to tools, execution and workflows; the start of the line on where testing stands

reason.zh: 直接关系到防御结论有多可信：读每项防御的实验段落，看它是否用会针对防御调整的攻击者检验过
reason.en: Bears directly on how far defence results can be trusted: read from the experiment passages of every defence

reason.zh: 把引用关系与共同实验资源连起来，是平台独有的视角
reason.en: Joins citations with shared experimental resources, a view only the platform has

reason.zh: 从“基准有多少”推进到“基准有没有被别人用、被谁用”
reason.en: Moves from how many benchmarks to whether, and by whom, they are used

reason.zh: 不同防御的结果能否积累，取决于它们能否比较：先看共享程度，再由 F16 看核心条件是否一致
reason.en: Whether defence results accumulate depends on comparability: sharing here, core conditions in F16

reason.zh: 把研究版图与知识更新连起来，形成有证据的研究议程
reason.en: Links the landscape to how knowledge updates, toward an evidence-based agenda

q.zh: 研究主题更新与验证方式更新是否同步？
q.en: Do evaluation methods update along with research topics?

conclusion.zh: 不同步：研究转向执行类软件场景时，这些工作在真实系统上实验的比例没有随之上升；被测对象是新的，但针对防御调整的攻击、对实际后果的直接测量较少，四项验证条件同时得到确认报告的比例也低。
conclusion.en: Not in step: as research turned to software settings where the agent acts, the share of that work run on real systems did not rise; what is tested is new, but attacks adjusted to the defence and direct measurement of real consequences are uncommon, and few papers confirm all four validation conditions.

shift.zh: 用最新模型、在 agent 系统上做实验，安全验证就到位了。
shift.en: Testing the newest models on agent systems means safety is properly validated.

shift.zh: 执行类场景的工作占比成倍上升，其中在真实系统上实验的比例没有随之上升；针对性攻击、后果层面的测量较少，四项条件同时得到确认报告的仍是少数。
shift.en: Work in software settings where the agent acts multiplied, while the share of it run on real systems did not rise; targeted attacks and measurement of consequences are uncommon, and few papers confirm all four conditions.

roles.zh: 这条线的出发点：研究对象变了。
roles.en: The starting point of this line: what research studies has changed.

roles.zh: 按半年对齐：执行类场景增多时，真实系统实验的比例没有随之上升。
roles.en: Aligned by half-year: as these settings grew, the share run on real systems did not rise.

roles.zh: 说明验证的对象是新的。
roles.en: Shows that what is tested is new.

roles.zh: 说明实验已进入系统层面，而不只测单个模型。
roles.en: Shows experiments reach the system level, not only single models.

roles.zh: 针对防御调整的攻击检验较少。
roles.en: Tests with attacks adjusted to the defence are uncommon.

roles.zh: 四项条件同时得到确认报告的比例较低。
roles.en: Few defences confirm all four conditions.

roles.zh: 明确涉及实际后果的主张，更常测不到相应层次。
roles.en: Claims that explicitly concern real consequences more often go unmeasured at that layer.

roles.zh: 主张与测量的不匹配，在明确涉及实际后果的子样本中更突出；多数主张与测量层次一致。
roles.en: The mismatch between claim and measurement stands out in the subsample that explicitly concerns real consequences; most claims match the layer measured.

roles.zh: 统计的是确认报告的条件，未说明不等于没有做。
roles.en: It counts confirmed conditions; not stated is not the same as not done.

roles.zh: 多数被识别基准尚未观察到外部采用。
roles.en: Most identified benchmarks are not yet seen in use outside.

roles.zh: 标签来自标题与摘要；摘要可能漏报实验细节，只测了两项验证指标。
roles.en: Labels come from titles and abstracts, which may leave out experimental detail; two testing measures only.

short.zh: 研究转向了，验证方式没有同步
short.en: Research turned; testing did not turn with it

q.zh: 研究之间有没有联系、结果能不能比较、验证依据是否来自足够不同的来源？
q.en: Are studies linked, can results be compared, and do checks come from different enough sources?

conclusion.zh: 共享基准连接了研究方向，但同名基准下仍普遍存在条件差异或信息不足；评测资源的使用也较集中在少数基准和闭源裁判上。
conclusion.en: Shared benchmarks connect research directions, but papers on a benchmark of the same name commonly differ in conditions or report too little; the use of evaluation resources also clusters on a few benchmarks and API-only judges.

shift.zh: 大家用同一个基准，结果就能横向比较；基准越多，共同基础越分散。
shift.en: When everyone uses the same benchmark, results can be compared; more benchmarks spread the common ground thin.

shift.zh: 在所比较的时间窗口内，基准变多时共用比例未见明确下降；但同名基准下普遍存在条件差异或信息不足，评测也较集中地使用少数基准和闭源裁判。
shift.en: Within the windows compared, sharing shows no clear drop as benchmarks multiply; but papers on the same benchmark commonly differ in conditions or report too little, and evaluation clusters on a few benchmarks and API-only judges.

roles.zh: 连接确实存在。
roles.en: The links are real.

roles.zh: 在所比较的时间窗口内，未观察到共用比例明确下降。
roles.en: Within the windows compared, no clear drop in sharing is seen.

roles.zh: 名字相同不等于条件相同：同名基准下普遍存在条件差异或信息不足。
roles.en: The same name is not the same conditions: papers on one benchmark commonly differ or report too little.

roles.zh: 使用论文更多的基准，条件也未见更一致。
roles.en: Benchmarks used by more papers are not seen to be set up more alike.

roles.zh: 无法判断的论文对是信息不足，不等于确认不可比。
roles.en: Pairs that cannot be judged lack information; that is not confirmed incomparability.

roles.zh: 评测资源使用较集中的直接证据。
roles.en: The direct evidence that evaluation resources cluster.

roles.zh: 开放权重模型的评测也多用 API 裁判。
roles.en: Even open-weight models are mostly judged by API models.

roles.zh: 多数使用仅 API 裁判；公开裁判提示词和报告人工对照的比例各约三分之一。
roles.en: Most use an API-only judge; about a third release the judge prompt, and about a third report a human comparison.

roles.zh: 大量记录是未说明，不能写成没有检查；用闭源裁判也不等于结果不可信。
roles.en: Many records do not say, which is not the same as no check; an API-only judge does not make a result untrustworthy.

roles.zh: 同家族评判较常见；这与资源集中是不同的指标。
roles.en: Same-family judging is common; it is a different measure from concentration.

roles.zh: 只确认了同家族评判的存在，没有检验它是否造成偏差。
roles.en: Same-family judging is confirmed, not shown to bias the results.

short.zh: 基准把方向连起来，条件却常不一致
short.en: Benchmarks link directions; set-ups often differ

q.zh: 围绕同一个成果，引用、采用、独立采用和跨方向迁移是什么关系？
q.en: For the same work, how do citation, adoption, independent adoption and movement across directions relate?

conclusion.zh: 多数基准引用未检测到实际使用，但引用量与使用量仍有关联；在已获得多次采用的基准中，使用主要来自外部团队。
conclusion.en: Most citations of benchmarks come with no detected use, though citation and use counts are still related; among benchmarks already used several times, use comes mainly from outside teams.

shift.zh: 被引多的成果，就是被广泛使用的成果。
shift.en: Highly cited work is widely used work.

shift.zh: 多数基准引用未检测到实际使用，但两者仍有关联；在已获多次采用的基准中，使用主要来自外部团队。
shift.en: Most citations of benchmarks come with no detected use, though the two are related; among benchmarks used several times, use comes mainly from outside teams.

roles.zh: 多数引用未检测到实际使用。
roles.en: Most citations come with no detected use.

roles.zh: 在同一张关系表上同时看引用与使用，结论不变。
roles.en: Reading citation and use on one table of pairs leaves the result unchanged.

roles.zh: 引用并非无用的信号：用了的大多会引用，两者中等相关。
roles.en: Citation is not a useless signal: most uses are cited, and the two counts correlate moderately.

roles.zh: 在已获多次采用的基准中，使用主要来自外部团队。
roles.en: Among benchmarks used several times, use comes mainly from outside teams.

roles.zh: 多数被识别基准尚未观察到外部采用，外部使用的结论只适用于已获多次采用的基准。
roles.en: Most identified benchmarks are not yet seen in use outside; the outside-use result holds only for benchmarks used several times.

roles.zh: 论文代码仓库的广泛 fork 和持续更新较少。
roles.en: Few paper code repositories are widely forked or kept up.

roles.zh: 跨方向的引用中，明示的使用更少。
roles.en: Across directions, explicit use is rarer still.

roles.zh: 测的是明示的使用；被吸收的概念可能只以背景方式被引用。
roles.en: It measures explicit use; an absorbed idea may be cited only as background.

roles.zh: 资源从哪里来：供给集中在少数机构。
roles.en: Where the resources come from: supply sits with a few institutions.

short.zh: 多数引用未检测到使用
short.en: Most citations come with no detected use

q.zh: 开放问题与外部反例出现后，研究如何回应，主张是否修订？
q.en: After open problems and outside counter-evidence, how does research respond, and are claims revised?

conclusion.zh: 被追踪的开放问题多获部分回应，以新方法为主；针对防御的外部反例不多，原团队后来多仍在发表，却很少引用这些反例（这与他们很少引用其他外部引用者相近），被挑战的论文也大多没有发布新版本。
conclusion.en: The open problems tracked are mostly answered in part, chiefly with new methods; outside counter-evidence against defences is uncommon; the defences' teams mostly keep publishing but seldom cite it (about as seldom as other outside works on their defence), and most challenged papers post no new version.

shift.zh: 防御被指出问题后，会被收紧或修订。
shift.en: Once a defence is shown to fail, it gets tightened or revised.

shift.zh: 外部反例不多；原团队后来多仍在发表，但很少引用反例，这与他们很少引用其他外部引用者相近；被挑战的论文大多没有发布新版本，发布了的少数中仅个别收紧了主张。
shift.en: Outside counter-evidence is uncommon; the teams mostly keep publishing but seldom cite it, about as seldom as other outside works; most challenged papers post no new version, and of the few that do, only one narrows its claim.

roles.zh: 被追踪的开放问题以新方法回应为主；样本是被三篇以上论文反复提出的问题。
roles.en: The problems tracked are answered mainly with new methods; the sample is problems raised by three papers or more.

roles.zh: 针对防御的外部反例较少，原作者后续引用更少。
roles.en: Outside counter-evidence against defences is uncommon, and its authors cite it even more rarely.

roles.zh: 测的是后来的引用与 arXiv 版本，不包括会议版、期刊版或后续论文里的修改。
roles.en: It covers later citations and arXiv versions, not changes in conference or journal versions or in later papers.

roles.zh: 原始防御评测条件的背景。
roles.en: Background on how the original defences were evaluated.

roles.zh: 原团队后来多仍在发表，但很少引用反例。
roles.en: The teams mostly keep publishing but seldom cite the counter-evidence.

roles.zh: 与引用其他外部引用者的比例相近：引用少是普遍情况，不是专门回避反例；反例样本较小。
roles.en: About as seldom as they cite other outside works: citing back is rare in general, not a particular avoidance; the counter-evidence sample is small.

roles.zh: 被挑战的防御论文大多没有发布新的 arXiv 版本。
roles.en: Most challenged defence papers post no new arXiv version.

roles.zh: 只比较了 arXiv 摘要；正文的修改不在内。
roles.en: Only arXiv abstracts are compared; changes in the full text are not.

short.zh: 问题多被部分回应；反例少被引用，论文也少更新
short.en: Problems answered in part; counter-evidence seldom cited, papers seldom updated

standards.zh: 比例旁同时给出分子、分母、单位、时间窗和缺失。论文、实验、论文对、资源、机构和“方向 × 季度”是不同单位。未结束的半年不与完整半年直接比较；等待时间要包含尚未发生事件的对象（删失）。
standards.en: Every share comes with numerator, denominator, unit, window and missing. Papers, experiments, pairs, resources, institutions and direction-quarters are different units. Incomplete half-years are not compared with complete ones; waiting times include objects still waiting (censoring).

standards.zh: 论文对共享论文、方向季度重复观察同一方向、多个实验可能来自同一团队，不能都当独立样本。行列独立基线只描述偏离独立分布，不定义应有研究量；家族重合要与流行度条件下的基线比较。
standards.en: Pairs share papers, direction-quarters repeat directions and experiments may share teams; they are not independent samples. Independence baselines only show departures, not how much research there should be; family overlap is compared with a popularity-conditioned baseline.

standards.zh: 保留所有候选、已试口径、失败的分析和版本变化；事后选择的阈值不能称为预注册。没有差异、趋势消失、预测增益很弱的结果同样保留。
standards.en: Keep all candidates, definitions tried, failed analyses and version changes; thresholds picked afterwards are not pre-registered. No difference, vanishing trends and weak predictive gains are kept too.
